scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @codex-ui/web && npm run build --workspace @codex-ui/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @codex-ui/server" "npm run dev --workspace @codex-ui/web"
